standard.summary: FID / LPIPS 指标使用的真实参照图片目录。留空时这两个指标会被跳过（日志告警），不会伪造分数。
standard.effect: FID 用该目录的真实分布与生成分布计算距离；LPIPS 按文件名把真实图与生成图一一配对计算感知距离。目录缺失或为空 → 对应指标 skip。
standard.whenToUse: 评估指标包含 fid 或 lpips 时必填；通常指向训练集或同分布的高质量参照集。
standard.avoidWhen: 只用 clip_score 等无参照指标时不需要；参照集与训练目标分布不一致时 FID 数值失去解释力。

standard_en.summary: The directory of real reference images used by the FID and LPIPS metrics. Left blank, both metrics are skipped (with a log warning) rather than given fabricated scores.
standard_en.effect: FID measures the distance between this directory's real distribution and the generated one; LPIPS pairs real and generated images by filename and measures perceptual distance. A missing or empty directory skips the corresponding metric.
standard_en.whenToUse: Required whenever the evaluation metrics include fid or lpips; it usually points at the training set or a high-quality reference set from the same distribution.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed with reference-free metrics such as clip_score; and FID loses interpretive value when the reference set's distribution does not match the training target.

advanced.principle: FID 是两组图像在 Inception 特征空间的 Fréchet 距离，需要足够数量的真实样本估计协方差（几十张以上才有统计意义）；LPIPS 是逐对感知距离，依赖文件名匹配建立真实-生成对应关系。
advanced.intervention: trainer_quality_runtime.py 读入；quality/quality_evaluation_metrics.py：_match_real_images 做真实图匹配，FID/LPIPS 分支在目录为空时 warning + return None（上层记 skipped）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 补齐参照后 FID/LPIPS 可用；评估耗时增加（真实集特征提取）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 小参照集（<50 张）的 FID 波动大；LPIPS 的文件名匹配约定要求生成侧命名与真实侧对应。

advanced_en.principle: FID is the Fréchet distance between two image sets in Inception feature space and needs enough real samples to estimate covariance (only statistically meaningful above a few dozen); LPIPS is a pairwise perceptual distance relying on filename matching to pair real and generated images.
advanced_en.intervention: Read in by trainer_quality_runtime.py; quality/quality_evaluation_metrics.py: _match_real_images does real-image matching, and the FID/LPIPS branches warn + return None when the directory is empty (the caller records skipped).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: With a reference set supplied, FID/LPIPS become usable; evaluation takes longer (real-set feature extraction).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: FID on small reference sets (<50 images) fluctuates heavily; LPIPS's filename-matching convention requires generated-side names to correspond to the real side.
